```{r}
library(RLHub)
library(RLSeq)
```

```{r}
base_url <- "https://rlbase-data.s3.amazonaws.com"
peaks <- "/peaks/"

peak_url <- paste0(base_url, peaks, "SRX1025894_hg38.broadPeak")
```

```{r}
rlr <- RLRanges(peaks = peak_url, genome = "hg38", sampleName = "SRX1025894")
rlr <- analyzeRLFS(rlr)
rlr
```
